result.summary: The environment features a wide, well-maintained sidewalk serving commercial retail, but lacks any visible marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. While a bus stop is present, the absence of safe crossing infrastructure creates a high-exposure environment for transit users and shoppers.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There is no designated crossing point for pedestrians to access the commercial storefronts or the bus stop.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide travel lanes
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway design without traffic calming encourages higher vehicle speeds in a high-pedestrian-demand area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the bus stop and potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically oriented toward the sidewalk and crossing areas to improve safety during evening hours.

result.summary: The street environment is highly car-oriented, featuring a wide multi-lane roadway with embedded trolley tracks and no marked pedestrian crossings. Although a sidewalk exists, the lack of crossing infrastructure and the long, unprotected distance across the road present significant safety risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Embedded Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Metal tracks in the pavement can be slippery when wet and pose a tripping hazard or a risk for bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway running longitudinally

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without any refuge or protection.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross, increasing the risk of mid-block collisions.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals despite the presence of sidewalks. The wide roadway and lack of clear crossing points create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians navigating between commercial and institutional land uses.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: Faded Lane Markings
hazards.description: Roadway markings are significantly worn, which can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and reduced driver awareness.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, increasing the risk to pedestrians at the curb edge.

interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow down right-turning vehicles.
